scope: Read review of isolated state machine, tests and README; independent local synthetic fixture tests only. No provider API, process control, production integration, canonical permit, or writer PASS.

independent_verification.test_source: Synthetic fixtures explicitly identified in test_state_machine.py; no live system supplied

reviewed_invariants: The protocol stores a detached canonical plan and checks its journal digest at every transition; callers cannot mutate returned plans/intents to change the durable operation.
Intents are appended with complete write-loop, fsync of file and directory, and one process lock before being returned; fsync failure poisons continuation and reopening first requires reconciliation.
Lost pause/install/resume replies produce read-only reconciliation under the existing operation ID; there is no timer-triggered resume, implicit PATCH replay, or new operation ID.

Provider disabled/running flags alone are insufficient: the normalized contract additionally requires complete process membership, zero live descendants/in-flight mutations, every writer accounted for, and exact phase-bound source identities.

Before installation every writer uses its before pin; after actual coherent installation the after pin is mandatory. A QUIESCED state without an issued installation boundary cannot claim COHERENT_AFTER.
Existing canonical admission remains required; prototype boundary has production_authorization=false and is not accepted by live installer.
Resume requires a coherent exact old/new version, independent DB/schema/file readback and preservation of newer operator changes; old DB restore is rejected.
Restored Running service additionally needs exactly-one-instance and actual loaded code proof; final state remains pending live acceptance.

issues_resolved_during_review.issue: Caller-owned mutable plan could rebind emitted supervisor/writer scope to an older journal hash.
issues_resolved_during_review.resolution: Canonical internal bytes, transition digest check, detached property/intent copies; targeted tests added.

issues_resolved_during_review.issue: A single before writer digest made real AFTER install reconciliation/resume reject changed writer source bytes; fixtures had hidden this.
issues_resolved_during_review.resolution: Separate source_sha256 and candidate_source_sha256 with exact coherent-version checks and genuinely different fixture pins; targeted phase test added.

documented_remaining_limits: This is not a deployable maintenance controller. Real graceful drain, complete process membership and authenticated evidence collection are not implemented.

Observation booleans/status strings/source-set hashes and canonical admission are trusted normalized inputs here; the prototype does not authenticate a JSON claim or verify the owner authorization hash.
Partial multi-supervisor pause remains fail-closed and has no selective retry/compensation. A production adapter needs terminal per-request reconciliation and bounded recovery before any real pause.
Current installed controller still requires CRM supervisor266084 enabled/Running; this prototype does not modify that condition and cannot authorize stopping CRM through that controller.
Persistent filesystem fences for the active photo/video/diagnostic/rebuild/specification writer paths remain separate required work; a quiescence prototype does not close the actual writer gap.
Long-backup freshness/rebinding, permanent locks, reader credentials, publication and live Stage3/4 acceptance remain unimplemented.
